notes: Corrected the focal query to follow the assigned USER->REACTION route directly (users joined to message_reactions via message_reactions.user_id, with message_id and reaction_type filtered on the reaction node itself) rather than detouring through messages. This still returns the union {U03ROBERT23, U_ROBERT} for the underspecified 'target_robert' obligation, matching both design alternatives; the solver must pick one and the ambiguity is intentional per resolution_mode. U01AGENBOT9 (acting agent, pre-existing eyes reaction on the anchor) and U08NICK23 (thumbsup on the anchor, wrong emoji/name) remain negative_referents because a solver ignoring either the name filter or the emoji filter could wrongly select them. Robert Chen (U_ROBERT) required an added #engineering channel membership and both Roberts required an added eyes-reaction row on the fixed anchor message, since only the acting bot's reaction pre-existed in the base seed. The thread reply 1706110000.000200 (Robert Chen) was already present in the base seed; 1706110000.000201 (Robert Walsh) was added purely as narrative symmetry per the design note and carries no weight in the selector. Actor U01AGENBOT9 already has documented membership in #engineering (C03IJKL9012), sufficient for conversations.history/reactions.get discovery of all bindings without any workspace-scope exception.
